dishes.name: Mecklenburger Rippenbraten
dishes.desc: Roast pork ribs stuffed with apples, prunes and dark bread, served with red cabbage. A Sunday dish of Mecklenburg inns.

dishes.name: Mecklenburg duck
dishes.desc: Roast duck stuffed with plums, apples and raisins, served with red cabbage and dumplings. A seasonal dish of Wismar and the lake country.

dishes.name: Kloppschinken
dishes.desc: Mild-cured pork ham that is beaten to tenderise it, then boiled and sliced. A Mecklenburg cold-cut speciality.

dishes.name: Schmandpudding
dishes.desc: Light pudding made from sour cream, eaten with fruit compote. A familiar Mecklenburg dessert.
